description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of task counts across different language families, categorized by model performance—specifically “better”, “mBERT”, “XLM-R”, and “same”. The horizontal axis represents language families with labels “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “task count” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each language family, there is a grouped set of three bars, one for each model performance category, indicated by distinct colors: “mBERT” is represented by a light blue bar, “XLM-R” by a dark blue bar, and “same” by a light green bar. In “IE-Baltic”, the “mBERT” bar reaches approximately 8, the “XLM-R” bar reaches approximately 9, and the “same” bar reaches approximately 5. The tallest bar on the chart, representing “Uralic” and “XLM-R”, reaches a value of approximately 37, and the shortest bar, representing “IE-other” and “mBERT”, reaches approximately 2. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
